name: beatupbuddy
title: beat up buddy
blurb: a "beat up a buddy" physics ragdoll wearing @mfzx.net's real avatar as its head, standing on a weighted base — pick a tool and swing, they wobble and cry out one of their real posts on every hit. rope to the head chokes: an o2 meter drains and, at @mfzx.net's own request, a critical reading hard-stops the game and redirects to a real kink-safety resource instead of letting it continue.
